Keystone: your basic attack gains a heavy weapon's weight-to-damage bonus even wielded one-handed (+1 damage per 10 weapon weight).
Keystone: pick an equipment slot — its items weigh 10% less, stacking with any other weight reduction on that slot.
Keystone: your Dexterity attack proc now strikes TWICE, but every attack deals 2 less damage — a faster, lighter flurry.
Keystone: every time your mana regenerates, gain armor equal to half your Intelligence.

Deal 1 damage to attackers when hit
Keystone: give up the Dexterity tempo/mana proc — instead, each time it would trigger, your next attack deals bonus damage equal to half your Dexterity.
Keystone: Determination can no longer gut your stats — its penalty floor rises from 10% to 50%, so low health never drops a stat below half its base.
Keystone: Determination's effect per point is amplified 50% — bigger stat swings, up AND down, as your health rises and falls.
Keystone: life steal no longer heals — stolen life becomes temporary HP (5 tempo) instead.
Keystone: armor you would gain becomes temporary HP (5 tempo) instead.
Keystone: damage is split evenly between health and mana. If mana runs dry, health takes the rest — and death still comes only at 0 HP.
Keystone: Determination now answers to your mana instead of your health — your stats swing as mana drains, not HP.
Haste you gain lasts 1 extra movement
Enlightened you gain grants +10% more crit chance (20% total)
Brace you gain blocks 10 more percentage points of damage
Blessed you gain draws 1 extra card per cycle
Blessed you gain lasts 1 extra cycle
Strengthen you gain deals 5 more damage per attack
Bolster you gain grants 5 more armor per charge
Cleanse you gain removes 1 extra debuff
Resilient you gain negates 10 more percentage points of damage
Bleed you apply deals 1 additional damage per tile moved
Stuns you apply last 1 additional tempo

Burn you apply deals 1 additional damage after each normal tick
Poison you apply: each tick has a stacks% chance to spike for 5 bonus damage
Cursed enemies deal 30% less damage instead of 20%
Cursed enemies deal 30% of their damage to themselves instead of 20%
Enemies take 5 damage when your Frozen thaws
Shock you apply lands 1 additional stack
Slows you apply make movement cost 4 tempo instead of 3
Roots you apply last 1 additional tempo
